items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: He had lost his bass player, who was Ted Sturgis, you know.

ctx.x: Todd and some different guys. It wasn't a leader. It was just about four or five guys working there. I can't remember all the guys. But anyway, and Luis Russell came through. He had lost his bass player, who was Ted Sturgis, you know. I don't know who he went with, but Ted left with somebody, so they asked me at the last moment if I would go with them. I said, 'Well, I can't go tonight.' So the cat said, 'Well, we'll take off. We'll cancel our St. Louis job if you'll go with us. We'll put it back.' So I told…
